title: Complete erasure run
statement: For Boolean words $w$ and $u$, after exactly $2(|u|+1)$ steps from the eraser configuration in state $0$ with $u$ on its tape and its head at displacement $0$, the machine is in state $2$ with a blank tape and its head at displacement $0$. The input remains $w$ and the output is empty.
replaced:
Erasing a complete administrative word $u$ costs exactly $2(\abs{u}+1)$
steps of the eraser, after which the tape is blank, the head and native
input position are restored, and nothing has been emitted.
